question: In a certain code language, LOOK is coded as 2330 and BALL is coded as 1413. How will HELP be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e881b0cb6b554a3b7a05e01e63ec9ff1b4ea4a264a8f34c6002f56efc9cad659.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

LOOK is coded as 2330.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f0d9e105826c85aa120098913e7c16328dbf02b2bcd1c6c0511c9b88f91bc73.png] 

and 

BALL is coded as 1413.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3c66133fc872c3716195240ffe98c221f887986a17f6a6855d26abae831dd01.png] 

Similarly,

HELP will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be26ee96f0ff099d31088c120d70bcdd28d744ce166c6f2f1fec5612ee385147.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"2417".**
